Your pick of the ship as the front door (cw-front-door A) already said Chapter 1 ends aboard. This stands unless you flip it.

questions.q: How much of the practice should a first-time player try before Chapter 1 ends?
questions.why_you: Your steer asks to lean into the book's mechanics so players taste the practice; the Kickstarter launches on this demo, so every addition delays it. Where to strike that trade is your preference, and it decides what the next two build threads add. Chapter 1 already uses the deck as a hand, the six faces as stances, the charge, the daemon families, push hands, the trust rules and the oath.
questions.not_before: You overruled cw-chapter1-first at 01:48 UTC on 2026-10-21; until then the world waited behind the demo.

options.label: A. Inside the beats (recommended)
options.c: No new beats. Each beat names its place, A3 earns the first vibeulon, and the demo ends aboard with the spirit asking about the player's blank card tomorrow, so the practice is the next visit. Two short build threads; the video follows.

options.label: B. A short epilogue aboard
options.c: After the hollow, three one-minute tries on the ship: care for your spirit (Clean Up), push hands with Yun at Root, and invite a friend into a Between. Roughly one more build round, and a longer video.

options.label: C. One card from every move
options.c: The hand deals one card each of Wake, Open, Clean, Grow and Show Up at fitting beats. Changes the card map and needs the guessing test rerun; the Challenger dissents until a second player has settled A6 and A8.
